prompt: Rendered in the style of pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a village market at dawn where soft gray lines define forms and pale watercolor tints suggest early morning light. On the far left stands a tall wooden cart with iron-rimmed wheels, next to which sits an old woman in a blue shawl on a woven mat. She holds a wicker basket filled with green apples, looking down at them with a gentle expression. Beside her, a small brown dog rests its head on her knee, eyes closed in sleep. A young boy in striped trousers points toward the center of the market, drawing the attention of a man in a red scarf who stands nearby holding a copper jug. The man in the red scarf looks at the boy while adjusting his collar with his free hand. In the center foreground, a large clay pot sits on the ground, steam rising faintly from its open top. Next to the pot, a vendor in a yellow tunic hands a loaf of bread to a customer wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The customer reaches out with both hands to accept the bread, their fingers nearly touching. Behind them, a white goat with curved horns stands tethered to a wooden post, chewing on a stray leaf. To the right of the goat, a stack of orange crates rises unevenly, topped by a black cat sitting alertly with its tail curled around its paws. A fishmonger in a rubber apron stands behind a table covered in silver fish, pointing at a specific trout for a woman in a floral dress. The woman in the floral dress leans forward, examining the fish closely with a critical eye. Above the table hangs a scale with two metal pans, one empty and one holding a single weight. Near the right edge, a bicycle with a rusted frame leans against a stone wall, its front wheel slightly turned. A teenager in a denim jacket walks past the bicycle, carrying a rolled-up newspaper under one arm. Further back, a lantern hangs from a beam, unlit but catching the first rays of sun. A rooster with bright red comb stands on a crate near the lantern, crowing into the quiet air. Finally, a child in a pink coat runs toward the background, chasing a rolling hoop that tilts precariously on the cobblestones. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the scene. There is no electric lighting fixture present. There is no vehicle with an engine depicted.
